name: – Michael Gahler – After § 61 – Am 22
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 61b. Expresses its concern over reports from certain local authorities in Member States, including Denmark, regarding instances of young people from Ukrainian refugee communities displaying symbols directly associated with Nazi ideology, which also constitute the symbolism of the UPA, whose members were responsible for mass crimes against Polish and Jewish civilians in Volhynia and Eastern Galicia; stresses the importance of historical education, intercultural dialogue and the unequivocal condemnation of all manifestations of Nazism, antisemitism, xenophobia and the glorification of perpetrators of war crimes;
